rules.title: Berkeley 2026 Annual General Adjustment
rules.requirement: The Rent Board set the 2026 Annual General Adjustment at 1.0%, 65% of the 1.5% CPI increase, usable no earlier than January 1, 2026. It cannot adjust rents for Costa-Hawkins tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025.
rules.coverage_conditions: Eligible landlords of fully covered units
rules.quoted_span: eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than

any.unavailable: single-family home with tenancy that began before 1996, or rooming house with five or more rooms rented individually

exempt_if.unavailable: exempt unit types (golden duplex, owner shares kitchen or bath, ADU with owner-occupancy, university unit, nonprofit cooperative)

notes: AGA order (Regulation 1148) adopted Oct 16, 2025; cites BMC 13.76.110A for the formula.
